description_expanded: Overview5.0(18 reviews)GULF PLACE – Sun Stone Steps from the Beach | Sleeps 6 DESCRIPTION Welcome to Sun Stone, a beautifully updated condo located in the vibrant Gulf Place Cabanas. This modern coastal retreat offers the perfect blend of relaxation and convenience, just steps from the beach, shopping, dining, and entertainment. Whether you're soaking up the sun or exploring the local area, this 1 Bedroom + Twin Bunk Room condo provides the ideal space for up to 6 guests. OUTDOOR LIVING & BEACH ACCESS Step outside the living room to enjoy the heated community pool (in winter months) and hot tub. The beach access is just a short stroll across the street, making it easy to enjoy the stunning Gulf Coast waters. HOME FEATURES 1 bedroom + enclosed hallway bunk room | 1 full + 1 half bathrooms | Sleeps 6 King-sized bed in the primary bedroom with a new smart TV Enclosed hallway bunk room with twin beds Queen sleeper sofa in the living room for extra comfort Fully equipped kitchen and cozy dining area for four Access to community pool, hot tub, and other community amenities DINING & ENTERTAINMENT Gulf Place Town Center just outside your door, offering dining, live music, and cozy fire pits Plenty of nearby cafes, restaurants, boutiques, and entertainment options Gulf Place also offers tennis, shuffleboard, and grilling areas for your enjoyment WHY STAY HERE? Ideal location near the beach, restaurants, shopping, and entertainment Access to resort-style amenities, including multiple community pools, hot tubs, and an amphitheater Enjoy the vibrant atmosphere of Gulf Place and the beauty of 30A Sun Stone offers everything you need for a relaxing and fun-filled vacation, with the beach and local attractions right at your doorstep.Show less
